# fal_environment (Resource)

A fal environment, which holds its own apps and secrets, the equivalent of `fal environments create`. Every account has a `main` environment, which needs no resource. Deleting an environment deletes everything in it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fal_environment" "staging" {
  name        = "staging"
  description = "Apps under test"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The environment's name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the environment. When not set, Terraform leaves the environment's description as it is, so importing an environment without copying its description is safe. fal cannot change a description in place, so setting a different one replaces the environment, deleting everything in it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the environment was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) The environment's name.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the account's default environment.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import fal_environment.staging staging
```
